svg.title: Where an extension reaches
svg.desc: An extension folder holds skills, commands and agent profiles, modules without a connector block, and modules with one. Skills, commands and agent profiles go to your Claude Code and OpenCode sessions. The tools and hooks of a module go to your sessions too: a module without a connector block is always on, and one with a connector block only while its switch on Set up is on. For workers the arrows are tool availability only. Workers you start get the module tools your session has, and workers the clone starts get them only where the module is marked as served to workers. A connector also gives clone turns the tools it declares for them. A worker can call a tool only when its profile names it.
